name: Mica
description: Mica flakes: thin hexagonal plates lying every which way and catching the light.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; @size: @pick(46%, 68%, 92%); -webkit-transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg)); transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg)); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(100.0% 50.0%, 75.0% 93.3%, 25.0% 93.3%, 0.0% 50.0%, 25.0% 6.7%, 75.0% 6.7%); clip-path: polygon(100.0% 50.0%, 75.0% 93.3%, 25.0% 93.3%, 0.0% 50.0%, 25.0% 6.7%, 75.0% 6.7%); opacity: 0.9; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
